items.title: A pragmatic solution to the cyber talent shortage: Co-sourcing
items.summary: CGI a récemment créé un partenariat avec Pierre Audoin Consultants (PAC) en vue d’étudier les tendances en cybersécurité au Royaume-Uni. Une des questions clés ayant été posées était : « Est-ce que la cybersécurité est actuellement trop difficile à gérer pour les entreprises? » Des quelque 230 répondants issus d’entreprises comptant 1 000 employés ou plus, seulement 21 % ont indiqué que leurs organisations exerçaient la totalité de leurs activités de cybersécurité de façon interne. Pourquoi seulement 21 %?

items.title: Final IRRBB regulations: Their implications and challenges
items.summary: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) recently published final interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB) regulations. As defined by the BCBS, “IRRBB refers to the current or prospective risk to the bank’s capital and earnings arising from adverse movements in interest rates.” To reduce excessive interest rate risk, banks will need to ensure that the right processes for identifying, measuring, monitoring and controlling IRRBB are in place. IT infrastructure alignment, in particular, is crucial to successful compliance with the new requirements.

items.title: Best value procurement recognizes vendors as experts
items.summary: As the failure of large information and communications technology (ICT) projects has become a matter of public discussion in several countries, the Best Value Procurement (BVP) approach is gaining rapid ground. BVP is a common sense procurement method that focuses on finding and empowering the best experts and removing barriers to project success, such as non-expert interference and restrictive procedures. A case study by the Performance Based Studies Research Group at Arizona State University documented that BVP is highly successful, with client satisfaction levels of 98%.
